accepted_boundary: host/testable Phase 12.3 local packet dispatch, ARP cache learning/resolution, outbound ICMP/ARP frame construction, request selection, and fake/trait-level one-shot transmit
accepted_components: local ARP and IPv4 ICMP echo request dispatch into caller-owned reply buffers
one-step NetworkDevice polling with caller-owned receive/transmit buffers
fixed-capacity allocation-free ARP cache and sender learning
cached-only outbound neighbor resolution from immutable ArpCache state
caller-buffered Ethernet II frame construction for resolved neighbors
caller-buffered Ethernet/IPv4/ICMP echo request construction for resolved neighbors
caller-buffered Ethernet/IPv4 ARP request construction for unresolved targets
immutable-cache outbound request selection between ICMP echo and ARP request frames
fake/trait-level one-shot NetworkDevice transmit after successful construction
